# Local book fixtures

This directory is for local smoke-test books. Binary books are intentionally ignored by Git and must not be redistributed.

The optional real-book tests currently recognize these filenames:

- `Jane+Eyre.pdf`
- `Harry Potter and the Goblet of - J.K. Rowling.epub`
- `Call+Me+by+Your+Name.mobi`

If a fixture is absent, its corresponding test is skipped.
